Title: Assembly Line
Subtitle: Reading Comprehension Passage B
Author: Shu Ting, translated by Carolyn Kizer
Content: We come off the factory night-shift
In line as we march towards home.
Over our heads in a row
The little trees are all sick,
Stripped of their color and shape.
It's not hard to feel for them;
We share the same tempo and rhythm.
Yes, I'm numb to my own existence
As if, like the trees and stars

:ibox:		 — Shu Ting, translated by Carolyn Kizer
from A Splintered Mirror: Chinese Poetry from the Democracy Movement, `1991`
	North Point Press
